name: The Angel of the Trial
description: An illusory angel of the Trial of Knowledge, reminiscent of Emrakul, who tells Nissa to stop being a piece and be the hand that moves.

description_citations.text: "The Hand That Moves" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: In the trial Nissa suffers a nightmare of an angel who says she can do anything, a voice she realizes was both Emrakul's and her own.
timeline.quote: The monster had taken over her body back on Innistrad.

citation.text: "The Hand That Moves" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: The illusory angel appears, asks if Nissa is pawn or queen, and tells her to stop being a piece and be the hand that moves.
timeline.quote: Stop being a piece, Nissa. Be the hand that moves.

citation.text: "The Hand That Moves" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Apr 2017.
